name: inf-dog-pack
note: L10 infected dog pack (E32-AC07/AC08): three inf.dog chase the idle courier from three sides through four slow runners at the game camera; the shipped corgi stands next to her and is never targeted or infected. Look for: dogs low and fast against the human silhouettes (gallop clip, not a trot), the pounce telegraph on the ground before each leap, the lunge-bite pose, cooldown pauses between bites, nobody invisible, the corgi staying a corgi.
